note: OI-4: every constant is DERIVED (forced by the object), SWEPT (measured across a range and pinned in a stable band with the sweep as its justification), or CONFESSED (chosen, and said to be chosen, with what would settle it). A constant with no entry is UNMARKED and `engine/constants_sweep` reports it. This file does not judge whether a derivation is good; it enforces that one is CLAIMED, which is the difference between an argument somebody can check and a number nobody can find the argument for.

BORN.why: A record enters whole. Aging halves it on each unconfirmed visit, so the start value fixes the scale and nothing else; 1.0 is the multiplicative identity and any other choice would be the same sequence rescaled.

N_ARROW_SIDES.why: An arrow has two endpoints. Not a parameter.

LOOPS_UNSEARCHED.why: Girth-by-BFS searches every fiber, so the count of declined searches is structurally zero. It exists to stay reportable if a bound ever returns; the (n-1)! brute force it replaced could decline and did.

DECLARED_WEIGHT.why: A declared correspondence is asserted, not scored, and there is no similarity to weight it by. The unit weight IS the assertion; apex-star's k/(k-1) implied weight is derived from it by the k=2 anchor.

EPS.why: A float guard against division by zero. Chosen at the scale where double-precision noise lives; no measurement justifies the exact value and none would change a result at any nearby value.

MIN_RATE_N.why: The operator's declared minimum n for a rate to be stated as a finding, with stability to ~10n. A policy threshold, not a measurement — and it was set after two rate claims flipped when n grew tenfold.

READ_BETA.why: THE OPEN ONE. The settler's inverse temperature on the read path. It entered as 1.0 with no derivation and no sweep. The operator has ordered the beta audit: sweep the floor and settlement outcomes across a range on fixed fixtures, pin inside a stable band with the sweep as justification, or report the instability as a finding about the physics. Until that runs this is confessed.

BIAS_WEIGHT.why: How hard the typed input pushes. Justified only as 'small enough not to clamp, large enough to move something' — which is an argument for a range, not for 0.35. A sweep on the battery fixtures would settle it.

MOVED_EPS.why: The shift below which a slot counts as unmoved. A noise floor chosen to sit under observed shifts; not swept.

BLOCK_CAP.why: Blocks above this size are not relaxed and are COUNTED as skipped rather than silently dropped. A compute bound, confessed as one — the honesty is in the counting, not in the number.

MOVED_CAP.why: How many moved slots the record carries. A transport bound; the remainder is counted and reported, never silently cut.

REGION_SIZE.why: The attachment lineup size. OI-17 says this should be the medium's MEASURED co-relaxation range rather than a number — the acceptance guard band is the measurement that would derive it, and until that closes the loop this is chosen.

NU_CAP.why: Longest nu-string rendered into a region. A transport bound on the attachment call; display trim never feeds computation (gate 8).

NEIGHBOUR_CAP.why: How many declared neighbours a compiled claim lists. A transport bound.

NU_BUDGET.why: How much nu-text the atlas page renders per view. A display bound: the atlas is a read surface and this decides how much of a claim is shown before it is trimmed, which never feeds computation (gate 8).

SHEET_WIDTH.why: Longest claim rendered into the portable export sheet. A display bound on a read surface; the full nu-string is what addresses and hashes, and trimming here never feeds computation (gate 8).

MAX_LABEL_CHARS.why: Longest gloss label rendered into a sheet's glossary line. Display only, on a read surface; the gloss itself is stored whole.

_MIN_FACE_CHARS.why: Shortest string treated as a face. A parser bound.

TOP_CLUSTERS.why: How many clusters the structure trace shows. Display only.

SETTLED_DEGREE.why: Degree at or below which a boundary site counts as settled for K. Chosen; K's three refusals to date did not turn on it, which is why it has not been forced by a measurement yet.

POLL_SECONDS.why: Daemon poll interval. Operational, not physical.

SAMPLE_EVERY_DAYS.why: How often the longitudinal battery samples. The operator asked for weekly.

JUMP_EVERY.why: How often the walk jumps rather than continuing its neighbourhood. An exploration bound predating the coverage term, which IS derived (unwalked mass, self-extinguishing) — this one should follow it and has not yet.

DRIFT_AFTER.why: Consecutive empty steps before the walk is judged drifting. Chosen.
